funnel.title: From sign-up to counselling
funnel.how: People who signed up in the chosen period, then how many of them finished onboarding and viewed their result. The last three steps count couples where both partners carry a changed copy of the same condition, and whether either partner booked or attended a counselling session. Percentages compare each step with the one before it.

modes.title: Read vs listen
modes.subtitle: Understanding gain by learning mode
modes.how: The average change in teach-back score (share of answers correct, in points) from before to after the result explainer, among people who answered both times. Grouped by the learning mode each person chose in onboarding.

notTracked: Marriage outcomes are not tracked or used as a measure of success.

equity.title: Equity by language
equity.footnote: Gaps of more than 5 points between languages are flagged for review.
equity.how: Each row covers people who use GeneBridge in that language. Understanding gain is the teach-back change in points. Counselling uptake is the share of people in an at-risk couple whose couple attended a session. Median days to referral runs from first viewing a result to the first counselling session. A row is flagged when its understanding gain or uptake is more than 5 points below the average for all languages.

exploring.title: Exploring to tested
exploring.subtitle: People who started without a result and later added one
exploring.how: People who began on the exploring path (no screening result, following conditions to learn about), and how many later connected a screening result. A direct measure of improved access. Groups under 10 are hidden.

scans.title: Reports scanned
scans.subtitle: Screening reports people photographed or uploaded
scans.how: Counts of scan_completed events: how many reports were read, by how many people, and the average seconds from upload to the findings being ready to check. No report content is logged. Groups under 10 people are hidden.

distance.title: Distance to care
distance.subtitle: How far the nearest verified professional was when people searched "Care near you"
distance.how: Counts of nearby_location_method events. Each holds only the search method, the distance chosen and a distance band for the nearest verified professional found, never a location or area. Long distances and "none" show where in-person care is hard to reach. Bands with fewer than 10 people are hidden.
